findings.evidence: The timeout field contains: "Leaving this field at its default is the right choice for most teams, and raising it is worth doing only when a specific integration needs the extra room." This uses recommendation language ("is the right choice", "is worth doing") instead of neutral description.
findings.fix: Rewrite the timeout field description to be neutral and descriptive rather than prescriptive. Example: "The timeout field takes a duration in milliseconds, with a minimum value of 1000. Most implementations use the default value; some integrations may require higher values for extended processing."
findings.violation: Reference page field description includes subjective recommendation instead of neutral, even description of the field.
